about_the_game:
Unlock act 4 of the story to find out who is behind the nefarious plot, then join forces to take them down!

This pack contains 9 new tracks, 17 new missions, and two unlockable rig skins! The new missions are available after completing the mission "Death Contract" which is included in the Act 3 Expansion pack.

New tracks!

Chaos - a SEQUENCE STORM Original
Don't Go - by 2DCAT
Long-Legged Lie - a SEQUENCE STORM Original
Overload - a SEQUENCE STORM Original
Syndicate - a SEQUENCE STORM Original
Throwing Myself In The Trash - by mark dormin
Wax and Wane - a SEQUENCE STORM Original
Wretched Hyena - by YOUNG JAGUAR

Unlockable bonus track: Antimony's Theme - a SEQUENCE STORM Original
